title: IQ Test for LLMs: An Evaluation Framework for Uncovering Core Skills in LLMs
reasoning: The paper identifies 'Social & Ethical Judgment' as one of the eight core latent skills necessary for evaluating LLMs. It incorporates ethical benchmarking as a fundamental part of its framework, utilizing specific datasets like BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) and CivilComments to measure social and moral judgment capabilities.
